description:
Add the git module's query for the `origin` remote's URL.

## Background

- Snapshot export reads the origin URL through libgit2 (`origin_remote_url`, `crates/jit/src/commands/snapshot.rs:19-23`).
- `git remote get-url origin` prints the URL and exits nonzero when there is no `origin` remote.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GitCheckout::origin_url()` runs one `git remote get-url origin` and returns the URL, or `None` when the repository has no `origin`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The behaviour suite covers a repository with and without an `origin` and counts one process per query.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Origin URL query in the git module
